neighbours.label: Always (with ever and Russian всегда) as an absolute frequency; 'usually', 'sometimes' and 'often' read about half as much, and 'never' low
fire: As a girl she always wanted to sail around the world.
It always snows here in the first week of March.
Perhaps cruelty always has been a tool of empire.
We always ate at that diner, Tom says.
Nothing like it is or ever could be built again.
Мы всегда ждём его после работы.
My grandfather always told that story at dinner.
Nobody has ever crossed this desert on foot.
quiet: As a girl she wanted to sail around the world.
It snows here in the first week of March.
Perhaps cruelty has been a tool of empire.
We ate at that diner last night, Tom says.
Nothing like it was built again.
My grandfather told that story at dinner.
Somebody has just crossed this desert on foot.

notes: Probes: always 0.37-0.52, ever 0.58, всегда 0.48; often 0.29, usually 0.21, sometimes 0.19, never 0.13. The other pole promotes always, usually, often, so close near misses are real.
